subtitle: Out Cebu · China Eastern Airlines
overview: Fly from Cebu to Shanghai on China Eastern Airlines and stay three nights in a 4★ hotel. Spend a whole day at Shanghai Disneyland, with the 1-day pass, round-trip transfers and a guide to help you into the park included, and enjoy the fireworks before heading back. The rest of the trip covers Xinshi Ancient Town with a Hanfu experience, the Bund, Nanjing Road and a few shopping stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Nov 11–14 2026 to Dec 9–12 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Xinshi Ancient Town: A restored old town where the tour offers a Hanfu costume experience and DIY lacquer fans.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland: Shanghai's Disney resort, with a full day in the park and a pick-up after the fireworks show.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's best-known pedestrian shopping street, lined with shops and neon signs.
placeDesc.The Bund: A historic waterfront promenade along the Huangpu River with colonial-era buildings and a skyline view.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A landmark TV tower in Pudong with its distinctive spheres, seen from outside on this tour.
placeDesc.World’s largest Starbucks Flagship Store: A large Starbucks flagship store in Shanghai, visited as a city-tour stop.
placeDesc.LV Mega Ship: A ship-shaped Louis Vuitton building in Shanghai, visited as a photo stop on the city tour.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple Market: A busy market area around the City God Temple in Shanghai's old town, good for snacks and souvenirs.
placeDesc.Huangpu River (optional cruise): Shanghai's main river, offered as an optional evening cruise for USD 30 per person.
